versions.changelog:
Initial release — generate PDFs and images from HTML with agentgen CLI and API.

- Convert HTML to PDF or image via simple CLI commands
- Free tier: no sign-up, 1 request/min, watermark on output
- Authenticated tier: remove watermark, higher volume, supports multi-page PDFs
- Upload temp assets for 24 hours to use in HTML
- Supports custom output formats and viewport sizes
- Clear guidance for inlining styles and referencing uploaded assets
